question: In which state of India is Kaziranga National Park located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kaziranga National Park** is located in the state of **Assam** in India.
 
• It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its significant population of the **Indian one-horned rhinoceros**.
 
• The park spans an area of approximately **430 square kilometers** and is characterized by its diverse flora and fauna.
 
• It is also home to large populations of **tigers, elephants, wild water buffalo, and swamp deer**.
 
• Kaziranga is recognized for its efforts in **conservation and protection of wildlife**, making it a prominent national park in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Assam is located in the northeastern part of India, known for its rich biodiversity and natural beauty.
 
• The state is bordered by Bhutan and Arunachal Pradesh to the north, Nagaland and Manipur to the east, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram, and Bangladesh to the south, and West Bengal to the west.
 
• Assam is also famous for its tea plantations, silk, and the Brahmaputra River, which flows through the state.
 
• The state capital of Assam is **Dispur**, located within the city of Guwahati.
